items.goal: Signed-in shoppers can change their password: an authorized ChangePassword GET/POST on a new Identity.API ManageController with a Razor view styled like Login, using the existing ChangePasswordViewModel, UserManager.ChangePasswordAsync and SignInManager.RefreshSignInAsync; plus a 'Change password' entry beside 'Log out' in src/WebApp/Components/Layout/UserMenu.razor (Authorized branch only) linking to that page through the IdentityUrl setting. No existing scenario fits: the UI verifier must use a dedicated shopper it seeds itself with a fake password (not alice or bob), or, if it must use alice, restore her original password afterwards.
